test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I organised my dressing table by putting all the rubber bands ______ the drawer
solution:
The correct answer is - **2) in.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The sentence describes the action of organizing a dressing table by putting all the rubber bands in a drawer. The blank requires a preposition that expresses the location of the rubber bands.
 
• The most appropriate option is "in" because it expresses the idea of putting something inside a container or space.
 
• The prepositions "for," "on," and "at" do not fit in the context of the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct option to fill in the blank is "in."
